Closing the loop on this one with the investigation result from the NetSuite developer.

The COGS GL was not recorded for these orders because the SKUs had zero inventory on hand at the time of fulfilment, specifically at TH Bangna Warehouse. With no on-hand quantity NetSuite cannot determine the item cost, so it does not post a COGS GL impact. Once stock is available again at that location the COGS GL will post correctly.

This is working as designed rather than a defect, so no code change is planned. If you see this on an order where the SKU did have stock at Bangna at the time of fulfilment, reply here with the order number and we will look at that case specifically.
